solution: Redis memory was saturated by untracked session keys. Flushed db 2 keys and increased maxmemory from 2gb to 8gb in redis.conf, then restarted redis-server.

qdrant_points.title: Resolving Redis Memory Saturation in checkout-service
qdrant_points.chunk_text:
Redis memory was saturated by untracked session keys. To resolve the issue, perform the following steps:  
1. Flush db 2 keys.
2. Increase maxmemory from 2gb to 8gb in redis.conf.
3. Restart redis-server.
